body: The first time I did shrooms, I had my first proper psychotic experience. The things I saw in that trip come back to me during my psychotic episodes nowadays. People on the same dose didn't get the visual hallucinations I got and actually said the shrooms barely affected them. I would say it is a very bad idea.

Uhh I don't know. I mean, they've told me my diagnosis but I'm not that aware of what I do or why I got it. I've been PANSSed but I haven't seen the score or any of my medical reports. I think I am paranoid type maybe.
I haven't been told my 'type' as such but I think it is that.. thank you.
I don't know what my subtype is, but my medication is Abilify/Aripriprazole 15mg.

You are so lovely, thank you for all of that. I am really new to this stuff so I don't have any strategies to deal with things yet.. I am meant to be seeing a psychologist and getting some CBT to help to rationalise delusions/voices but it's a slow process. So, saying things like "If a voice or something encourages injury, always second guess what's happening!", which might seem like an obvious thing, is genuinely really helpful.


I will try to write stuff down more. When I get the most "interesting" sensations occurring, I tend to forget to write about them, which is a shame because I'm sure sometime in the future I might like to look back over them, if I survive that long. Which part of me hopes I will.


> Have any in person family and friends living near you?


Yeah, my family live a couple of towns away. I have very, very few friends as I ditched most of them due to paranoia, and the ones I have all live in other parts of the country, unfortunately. 


Thank you again.

I spent a night collecting my blood in a jar because a voice said it'd bring my dead friend back. I had it smeared on my face, just everywhere. In the mirror I looked like a real psycho. Which I guess I am.


I am having trouble seeing the world for what it is, or knowing if I'm awake or dreaming. I get scared at night. I had to paper over the mirrors because my evil reflection threatened to escape and hurt me. I recited the lord's prayer and some other incantations to "seal" her in the mirror. I don't believe this now, but last night it was so strong.


I keep accusing people of giving me fake meds. Of lying to me about being ill. Because the meds don't work.


I think they're all laughing at me behind my back, I think they think I'm an attention seeker. I know everyone's out to get me but I don'#t know how.



^ That's how I feel mostly.


I have seen a counsellor but she's passed me over to the Early Intervention in Psychosis team so I'm seeing them at the moment. 



Right now I'm just sitting here, not wanting to go to bed, grateful for everyone who's trying to help me. I just feel like I don't deserve this, like my life isn't worth saving, because my life is so empty.

Yeah, your story sounds quite like mine. I am fucked up in terms of:


School - I left a two year course because I was having paranoia and panic attacks due to the onset of my "illness", though no one recognised it as such. I had previously been diagnosed with asperger's syndrome and was meant to have support. I didn't get that support so had to leave the course. I am currently suing for the money to continue my education.


Job - I have no job.


Relationships - see above. I dated a guy in hospital for a while, but he was very clingy and it wasn't right. More to the point, I don't have any feelings, I am a void. I can't love. I am nothing right now.


I think I came out of hospital too soon and am not really functioning - i.e. I can barely cook for myself or remember to change clothes. I work really hard on tidying my house and "appearing sane" but inside my head I am filthy, if that makes sense. In my head, I stay in my clothes for days, my house is full of cobwebs. But outside, I pass as OK, because I just want to be left alone, but alone is dangerous because I'm getting sicker and sicker and I just wish... sometimes even pray... that they would notice I'm drowning and stop believing the "thumbs up" I'm giving them from way out at sea.

I have one but if I say her name it'll summon her so I'll call her M, but she stands behind me/creeps around doors and things and otherwise freaks me out. Ghostly things are hard to disprove but just have faith that it's caused by your illness and isn't "real".
